headline: Jodi Peterson-Stigers wins City Club of Boise civic award
pages: Jodi Peterson-Stigers received the City Club of Boise's 2026 Stimpson Award for Civic Engagement at Treefort Music Hall on Tuesday, Nov. 17, according to Boise State Public Radio, which posted the event audio on Nov. 18.
The annual award recognizes civic engagement in the Boise community.
